# PathSnap Phase 2 — Common Evaluation Report

**Generated by:** L A Gokul (`src/evaluation/common_evaluator.py`)
**Evaluation Scope:** Held-out student_test (10 trips, 19,160 GPS observations)

## 1. Primary Map-Matching Performance Metrics

| Metric | Classifier-Only (Greedy) | Classifier + HMM/Viterbi | Empirical Gain (Δ) |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| **Observation Top-1 Accuracy** | 63.57% | **73.62%** | **+10.05%** |
| **Route Continuity (1-hop)** | 83.82% | **95.11%** | **+11.29%** |
| **Multi-Hop Reachability** | N/A | **99.82%** | Consistent Topology |
| **Route Arc F1 Overlap** | 0.6395 | **0.8207** | **+18.12%** |
| **Candidate Miss Rate** | 0.1518% | 0.1518% | **99.85% Recall** (R=100m, K=10) |

## 2. Key Findings & Diagnostic Observations

- **100% Improvement Rate:** HMM/Viterbi improves observation accuracy and route continuity across all 10 out of 10 student-test trips.
- **Urban Clutter Resilience:** In dense urban areas (Trip 00000009), Top-1 accuracy jumps from 34.27% to 55.92% (+21.65%) because Viterbi resolves parallel street ambiguities.
- **Continuity Restoration:** Greedy classifier predictions frequently jump between opposing road carriageways; HMM enforces road graph directed transitions, raising continuity from 83.82% to 95.11%.
- **Production Speed:** Full end-to-end inference takes 3221.0 ms per trip (~1.68 ms per GPS observation).
